title: AMS Runbook: Change Vendor Bank Details
content: Use transaction XK02 to change vendor bank details. Check changes in FK04. Dual approval via email to Finance Controller.

title: PO Release Strategy Troubleshooting
content: If PO has no release strategy, check characteristic values and classification of the release strategy for the plant. Confirm release group and code.

title: Posting Period Checklist
content: Check period control for the company code, then the posting period variant assignment. Open the period with Finance approval.
note: Incomplete for S/4HANA: no asset period or custom validation checks.

title: Notes: ZFI_DAILY_UPLOAD cancelled
content: If ZFI_DAILY_UPLOAD is cancelled, just restart from SM37 in the morning.
note: Contradicts root cause found in SYN-H032.

title: IDoc Reprocessing Guide
content: For IDocs in status 51, read the error text first, fix the cause, then reprocess via the standard IDoc reprocessing transaction. Do not force-process.

title: Cendana PR Approval Matrix
content: Approval thresholds by document type. ZNB: manager approval above 5,000 MYR. Managed through flexible workflow.
